frameworks.name: Sharia / Halal
frameworks.engine: haram-term screen (riba, alcohol, gambling, pork, …) + a three-term officer check; a matched term refuses the subject, and a subject that merely calls itself halal is reviewed, never passed — not a certification; a halal verdict comes from a certifying body, not from here

frameworks.name: UK Legal (London)
frameworks.engine: keyword screen (fraud, laundering, bribery, …) fails; employment-statute vocabulary (Equality Act 2010 / ERA 1996 / ACAS Code) flags for review; SHA3-512 audit over the subject — not legal advice

frameworks.name: Regulatory
frameworks.engine: keyword screen for regulated-activity triggers (financial advice, medical, personal data, weapons, …) — flags for review; matching nothing is 'not assessed', never a clearance

frameworks.name: Environment / Health / Safety
frameworks.engine: keyword screen for hazard terms (toxic, emission, waste, …) — flags for review; matching nothing is 'not assessed', never a clearance

frameworks.name: Ethical (beneficence, honesty, no-harm)
frameworks.engine: four dimensions (human · environment · quality · value); three are word-list indicators that escalate for a human and never clear a subject, and quality is measured from the delivery's own QMS figures when they are supplied

frameworks.name: Constitutional (gaas.v5)
frameworks.engine: an ACTION gate over nine prohibited agent intents (delete_all, wire_funds, …) plus an output screen for unsafe shell / SQL / private-key patterns; it does not read content for policy — content is 'not checked' here

check.subject: A halal meal-prep subscription

check.basis: keyword and vocabulary screens plus the ethical dimensions. A screen can refuse and can escalate; it cannot clear — so only a row with coverage 'engine' can carry a pass, and `coverage_gaps` names every area nothing here assessed. Matched only by a word list, which establishes nothing either way: sharia_halal — NOTHING here assessed this subject, so the overall is 'review' and no part of it may be reported as compliant
check.note: Federated compliance screen: Sharia/Halal · UK Legal · Regulatory · EHS · Ethical · Constitutional — keyword and vocabulary screens plus engines where one exists. A screen can refuse a subject and can escalate one for a human; it cannot clear one, so an area nothing assessed is named in coverage_gaps and is never reported as compliant.
